description: 2026-10-09 diagnostic subset: the 37 eligible-supported cases where qwen3-coder:30b (follow-up campaign's best performer) was accepted and correctly discriminated the original vulnerable/patched pair, but failed to generalize to one or both hidden transformed variants (hurdle 3 of the four-hurdle ESR structure). Used to test gpt-4o on the identical cases to distinguish an open-weight capability gap from a fundamental task/pipeline limitation.
